title: cos(1) is constructed as a total, axiom-free CReal value
statement: The cosine of 1 (radian) is built as CReal.mk on an explicit, concrete regular sequence -- speedup(diagonal(cosSeriesPartial), K) -- via the same CONSTRUCTION pattern as CReal.e, never Exists-elimination into data. cosSeriesPartial n := sumRange cosTerm n sums the alternating series sum (-1)^k/(2k)! for k<n. This is the kernel's first transcendental-function-family value (Spivak Ch.15's cos(1)); its domination bound reuses CReal.e's own expDominant/expDominantCauchy machinery unchanged rather than deriving a new geometric bound. Admitted by the trusted kernel gate with an empty axiom footprint.

evidence.supports: CReal.cosOne is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example kernel_declaration_projection -- --require-declaration CReal.cosOne --require-kind definition 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^found[[:space:]]creal[[:space:]]definition[[:space:]]CReal\.cosOne[[:space:]]'
evidence.notes: CReal.cosOne is a Declaration::Definition. theorem_dependency_inventory / nat_theorem_inventory / prelude_theorem_inventory all filter to Declaration::Theorem and exclude Definitions, so this fact uses the DIRECT 'kernel_declaration_projection --require-declaration' checker (added earlier in this session's batch): it searches every constructed prelude's environment for an exact display-name match and exits non-zero on no match or kind mismatch. Verified on this tree: the command prints exactly one 'found\tcreal\tdefinition\tCReal.cosOne\t...' line (a definition built this early in the dependency order also shows up, separately, under the downstream complex/cpoint preludes that rebuild CReal from scratch as their own Kernel instance -- this checker deliberately anchors on the creal row only, the prelude CReal.cosOne is native to). --release is MANDATORY: this tool also builds creal/complex/cpoint, which overflow the default debug thread stack.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the creal prelude's trusted surface is empty, which bounds CReal.cosOne
evidence.notes: Re-measured on this tree: creal: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0, exits 0 printing 'ok: creal trusted surface = 0'. That bounds every declaration in the creal environment, including CReal.cosOne, since a declaration cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain. --require-axiom-free <name> errors for a prelude never built by this run rather than silently passing on zero rows. --release is MANDATORY here.

notes: depends_on is empty for the same reason F:creal-e's and F:creal-integral's are: cosOne's own direct building blocks (CReal.cosSeriesPartial, CReal.cosTerm, CReal.speedup, CReal.mk, the diagonal sequence, and the REUSED CReal.e Cauchy-witness machinery) are either plain Definitions (nothing to register as a proposition) or private/already-namespaced helpers. The propositions ABOUT cosOne (convergence, numeric bounds) are the separate facts F:creal-cosoneconverges, F:creal-cosone-le-four, F:creal-neg-four-le-cosone.
